name: signal
description: Signal Messenger channel via self-hosted signal-cli REST API

required_secrets.name: signal_api_url
required_secrets.prompt: Enter the base URL of your signal-cli REST API (e.g. http://localhost:8080). SECURITY: After install, restrict the HTTP allowlist in capabilities to match this host exactly.

required_secrets.name: signal_number
required_secrets.prompt: Enter the registered Signal phone number (E.164 format, e.g. +12345678900)

http._note: signal-cli is self-hosted. If your instance runs on a non-loopback host, add it here. Never use '*' in production.
